fields.title: Gas and water location
fields.finding: Bores must be vented. Material water is counted once in material mass; exterior .1 kg/m² water is separate. More external water can erase the margin.
fields.proposed_fix: Verify bore venting, actual liquid retention/drainage and material moisture at launch.
